_comment: Models to compare. Bedrock ids are used as-is. 'openai:<model>' and 'gemini:<model>' call those APIs directly (need OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY). The OpenAI/Gemini names are best guesses for current small/fast models: confirm with --list-models openai|gemini. Bedrock ids: aws bedrock list-inference-profiles --region us-west-2. Delete any you don't want.
